title: Latvia digs anti-tank trenches, installs dragon’s teeth along its border with Russia
summary: Construction of the Baltic Defense Line is continuing along Latvia's eastern border with Russia. The fortifications are designed to impede the movement of potential enemy military equipment and include anti-tank trenches and concrete "dragon's teeth" obstacles.

title: German government explains conditions under which Merz willing to speak with Putin
summary: German Chancellor Friedrich Merz is generally willing to hold talks with Russian President Vladimir Putin. However, such contact must have a specific purpose, while Berlin still sees no willingness on Russia's part to achieve a just and lasting peace in Ukraine.

title: Nine foreigners suspected of trying to join Russia's war against Ukraine arrested in South Africa
summary: Nine foreigners have been arrested in South Africa after they were caught allegedly trying to leave the country to fight in the war between Russia and the Ukraine.

title: Russian troops use recruited Africans as human shields in kill zone – intelligence
summary: Servicemen of the 39th Motor Rifle Brigade of the Russian Armed Forces are using recruited Africans as human shields while moving through the kill zone.

title: DIU examines new Russian Geran-5 K5-K drone: Nearly 100 foreign components, most of them American
summary: The Defense Intelligence of Ukraine (DIU) has published information on the components of a new Russian Geran-5 K5-K unmanned aerial vehicle.

title: Trump hopes to meet Xi and Putin at APEC summit in China
summary: U.S. President Donald Trump said he expects to meet Chinese President Xi Jinping and Russian President Vladimir Putin at next week's APEC summit in China, where he plans to discuss, among other issues, ending the war in Iran and denuclearization.

title: Zelensky explains why Ukraine cannot trade Donbas for security guarantees
summary: President Volodymyr Zelensky said that conceding Donbas would not guarantee peace for Ukraine, as Kremlin leader Vladimir Putin could use such a move merely as a pause before launching another act of aggression.

title: Russian forces attack Zaporizhzhia with drones, sparking fire, injuring residents
summary: Russian forces attacked Zaporizhzhia with strike drones. Private homes were hit, and residents were injured.

title: Zelensky discusses trilateral meeting in Abu Dhabi with Stubb
summary: President Volodymyr Zelensky discussed trilateral talks between Ukraine, the United States, and Russia in Abu Dhabi with Finnish President Alexander Stubb, stressing that Russia must also be committed to de-escalation and achieving genuine peace.

title: Commander of Ukraine's 7th Air Assault Corps explains why defenders withdrew from Pokrovsk
summary: Yevhen Lasiychuk, commander of Ukraine's 7th Air Assault Corps, said that in the summer of 2025, the Defense Forces gave up Pokrovsk in Donetsk region in order to deploy reserves to Dobropillia and thwart Russia's plans to encircle the entire Donetsk region.

title: No enemy activity observed in Chernihiv region or along border with Belarus – Demchenko
summary: Russian forces are not conducting offensive operations directly along the border in Chernihiv region, and no active enemy movements have been observed along the border with Belarus.

title: Russians attack energy infrastructure in eight regions overnight
summary: Russian forces have been striking energy infrastructure in eight regions since last night.

title: Naftogaz to receive €23M from the Netherlands for gas purchases
summary: Naftogaz Group has signed an agreement under which the Netherlands will provide €23 million through the European Bank for Reconstruction and Development (EBRD) to fund additional gas purchases.

title: Parliament passes law to combat bribery of foreign public officials
summary: The Verkhovna Rada has passed a law that strengthens penalties for bribing foreign public officials in international business transactions.

title: Trilateral talks begin in Abu Dhabi – Umerov
summary: Trilateral talks involving Ukraine, Russia, and the United States have begun in Abu Dhabi, the capital of the United Arab Emirates, with a focus on ending the war.

title: Sybiha discusses strengthening Ukraine’s air defenses with French FM
summary: Ukrainian Foreign Minister Andrii Sybiha has discussed the battlefield situation, peace efforts, and ways to bolster Ukraine’s air defenses with his French counterpart, Jean-Noël Barrot, during talks in Paris.

title: Drone attack kills two in Ladyzhyn
summary: Two people have been killed and civilian infrastructure has been damaged in a drone attack on Ladyzhyn in the Vinnytsia Region.

title: Abu Dhabi talks: Ukrainian delegation holds first meeting
summary: The Ukrainian delegation has begun its work in the United Arab Emirates.

title: Sybiha meets Rubio on sidelines of G7 meeting in Paris
summary: Ukrainian Foreign Minister Andrii Sybiha began bilateral talks with US Secretary of State Marco Rubio in Paris on Tuesday, November 10, on the sidelines of the G7 foreign ministers’ meeting.

title: Migratory birds found dead following explosions in Odesa region
summary: Song thrushes migrating south have been found dead near the Tuzly Lagoons National Nature Park in the Odesa Region following powerful explosions.

title: Russian drone strikes commuter train in Sumy
summary: A Russian drone struck a commuter train at a railway station in Sumy. No casualties were reported.

title: US urges Russia to give Europe a seat at the table in Ukraine peace talks – Politico
summary: US presidential envoys are urging Russia to agree to European participation in the next round of negotiations aimed at ending the war in Ukraine.

title: Ukrainian delegation arrives in Abu Dhabi for trilateral talks
summary: The Ukrainian delegation has arrived in Abu Dhabi, the United Arab Emirates, where trilateral talks involving Ukraine, Russia, and the United States are scheduled to take place on November 10–11.

title: Russia strikes retail facility in Kropyvnytskyi
summary: Russian forces struck civilian infrastructure in Kropyvnytskyi.

title: Drones attack aircraft repair plant in Russia’s Novgorod region
summary: Drones attacked the 123rd Aircraft Repair Plant in the city of Staraya Russa in Russia’s Novgorod Region overnight into Tuesday.

title: War update: 156 clashes on front line over past day, fiercest fighting in Pokrovsk sector
summary: A total of 156 combat engagements between Ukraine’s Defense Forces and Russian invaders were recorded along the front line on November 9.

title: One killed, eight injured in Russian attacks on Sumy region over past day
summary: One man was killed and eight other people were injured in Russian attacks in the Sumy region.

title: ADF down 135 of 162 Russian drones launched against Ukraine overnight
summary: Ukraine’s air defense forces neutralized 135 of the 162 drones launched by Russian forces against Ukraine since the evening of November 9.

title: Russia’s war casualty toll in Ukraine up by 2,220 over past day
summary: Russia's total combat losses in its full-scale invasion of Ukraine from February 24, 2022, to November 10, 2026, amount to approximately 1,611,600 personnel, including 2,220 over the past 24 hours.

title: Around one million people live in Ukrainian-controlled part of Zaporizhzhia region – regional authorities
summary: Around one million people live in the part of the Zaporizhzhia region under Ukrainian control, more than 230,000 of whom are registered as internally displaced persons (IDPs).

title: Ukrainian polar researchers capture rare optical phenomenon near Akademik Vernadsky station
summary: Ukrainian polar researchers have captured a rare optical phenomenon – the iridescence of cirrus clouds – in the sky near the Akademik Vernadsky Antarctic station.

title: Estonian FM discusses support for Ukraine with Lithuanian and Swedish counterparts
summary: Estonian Foreign Minister Margus Tsahkna hosted his Lithuanian and Swedish counterparts, Kęstutis Budrys and Maria Malmer Stenergard, in Tallinn, where they discussed continued support for Kyiv, Russia's isolation, and the use of frozen Russian assets to rebuild Ukraine.

title: Zelensky: Ukrainian culture powerful voice that resonates around the world
summary: Ukrainians are united by the understanding that culture and art are essential and important, and that they are part of our diplomacy – a voice that is heard everywhere.

title: Ukraine to receive USD 400M worth of weapons soon, Pentagon confirms – Sienik
summary: The Pentagon has informed Ukraine that it will be able to receive weapons worth $400 million in the near future under the Ukraine Security Assistance Initiative (USAI) for the current fiscal year.
